title: Copperleaf at The Brooks, Estero FL: Why Does Estero's Lowest-Density Bundled Golf Cost the Most in 2026?
excerpt: Copperleaf at The Brooks is a 570-home bundled golf community in Estero with the lowest homes-to-holes ratio in the market, about 32 homes per hole. The club's own 2025 sheet totals $14,828 a year, before the Brooks II CDD assessment, the neighborhood association, or the beach club.
